selection_rubric_frozen_before_applicati: 1. MANDATORY LANE: at least one filing-event (A4) proposal must be selected IF any A4 proposal is eligible (plan sec2 axis 1 is the mandatory lane); if no A4 proposal is eligible the lane's death is a measured cycle outcome, recorded, never rescued

2. ELIGIBILITY GATES (measured, pre-selection): pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs ALL ELEVEN veto entries (fail-closed: a null veto measurement fails the gate) AND anchor-vs-control |rho| strictly below the proposal's own declared gate AND A9-F feasibility RUNNABLE (a sham/falsification control that cannot run is a design failure, not a pass)
3. COVERAGE RANK among eligible proposals: measured anchor pairs
4. LANE DIVERSITY: the selected families come from different lanes when more than one family is selected (cannot bind on a singleton eligible set)
5. BUDGET: at most two families x three arms = 6 scored cells (the cycle's entire budget); unused slots are never reassigned

selection.rationale: rubric applied in frozen order: (1) the mandatory filing-event lane has NO eligible proposal — both A4 proposals measured INELIGIBLE vs momentum_63s at 0.219/0.2192; the lane dies as a measured outcome and is recorded, not rescued; (2) the eligible set is the singleton {SFV11-A5-H1} (eleven/eleven vetoes measured, max 0.1554 with margin +0.0446, control identifiable at 0.0792 << 0.30, A9-F RUNNABLE); (3) coverage rank trivially orders the singleton; (4) lane diversity cannot bind on one family; (5) budget: 1 family x 3 arms = 3 scored cells of 6 — the three unused slots are dead forever, never reassigned

mandatory_lane_statement: The plan's mandatory filing-event lane was proposed (two outcome-blind A4 proposals), funded (P0/P2), and measured (D2). Both proposals measured ineligible on the preregistered novelty bar vs momentum_63s (thin margins -0.019/-0.0192 per P-2). Per the frozen rubric's step 1, the lane dies as a MEASURED CYCLE OUTCOME; nothing is rescued, re-cut, or re-measured (no parameter weakening). A negative mandatory-lane result is a successful research outcome per plan sec 0.
